propositions: GitHub Actions run logs and metadata are retained only temporarily, so coverage % and CI-health metrics (status, duration, red-to-green recovery, flake rate) must be harvested and persisted into a durable, git-tracked `.rebar/metrics-snapshots.ndjson` store to maintain historical trends.

Coverage % is parsed from the pytest-cov `TOTAL` line in run-log tail via word-boundary grep, and CI-health (status/conclusion, duration, red-to-green recovery interval between fail-then-pass run pairs, recheck/flake rates) is extracted from run metadata via the Actions API.

The optional isolated adapter in `src/rebar/metrics/adapters/github_actions.py` is not imported by core metrics modules, preserving portability and allowing future parallel adapters for other CI systems.

The persistence harness (`scripts/harvest_gha.py`) runs locally or by a maintainer to pull recent `test.yml` run history and append labeled snapshots to the tracked store; the CI workflow is NOT modified to write snapshots because CI jobs have read-only permissions and ephemeral checkouts.

Unit tests validate adapter extraction logic against fixture log text and run-metadata JSON (no network), confirm snapshots are written to the correct tracked store path (not `reports/`), and assert the core module isolation rule.
